summary: Allarity Therapeutics filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, disclosing an October 30, 2026 press release update on its Drug Response Predictor technology, patent portfolio, and in-house laboratory capabilities supporting stenoparib development. No transaction, stake, price, premium, or advisor is stated. The filing is a routine Item 8.01 other-events disclosure of scientific and intellectual-property progress, not a special situation. For risk-arb purposes, no deal terms or catalysts exist; monitoring remains limited to clinical, partnership, and financing developments unrelated to corporate-control events.
